title: The fastest Chimera Ant in the world picks a fight with the wrong smoker

cuts.voiceover_text: Cheetu, a cheetah-headed Chimera Ant with purple hair and yellow eyes, is dancing around a huge silver-haired man sprawled out in a grassy field. That man is Morel, the smoker, resting on his back with his giant pipe next to him and dark sunglasses on. Cheetu keeps demanding a game of tag, blurring in and out at impossible speed, crouching on Morel's chest and yelling how close he is, absolutely certain the smoker is just playing possum.

Morel doesn't even open his eyes. He tells the cheetah to do whatever he wants, but he isn't getting up for the next five hours. Watching from a distance, an ally notes Cheetu's new ability still needs work, that he's obsessed with challenging people to foot races and desperate for attention. Cheetu keeps prancing around the pipe, taunting, sure that the moment Morel gives up and steps away, he wins.

Hours later, Cheetu is strutting around convinced the match hasn't even started, when Morel finally sits up grinning and tells him to look at his own ankle. A thin white rope of nen smoke is coiled around Cheetu's leg, trailing all the way back across the field to Morel's giant pipe. While Cheetu was showboating, Morel had slowly walked a huge smoke lasso around him. Cheetu's fangs bare, sweat pours down his face, and the pipe slowly reels the rope in.

Cornered, Cheetu refuses to lose face and forges a brand new ability on the spot, summoning a small purple bow-claw onto his hand. Morel just stares at him from behind his sunglasses and asks why he'd invent a weapon slower than himself. Then, flatly, Morel tells him exactly why he's going to lose: because he's an idiot.

The instant Cheetu strikes, the Morel in front of him dissolves into smoke. The real Morel steps out from behind, calmly explaining that while Cheetu preened and cackled, he crafted a smoke duplicate of himself, then hid his true body under smoke shaped like grass and simply walked the other way. His decoy went one direction, he went the other. Cheetu, wide-eyed and speechless, finally throws up his hands and quits, muttering that he's done.
